notes: The copula is placed on the fronted preposition in both clauses because the prepositional phrase is the predicate and the nominal beside it the subject (rule 49); no nominal predicate stands in either clause to draw it away.

`הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה` → *the first course*: the noun's own article takes the single written *the* and the agreement article is `unrepresented`, which rule 47 directs expressly notwithstanding the English reordering of the determiner before the adjective.
